behaviors.description: Internal word splitter: NFKD-normalize, strip combining diacritics (U+0300-U+036F), split camelCase boundaries, split on non-alphanumerics, drop empties, lowercase each word.

slugify(input, options): throws TypeError('slugify expects a string') for non-strings; joins words with options.separator (default '-'); when options.maxLength is an integer and exceeded, slices to maxLength and strips trailing separators.

truncate(text, max, ellipsis): ellipsis defaults to '...' only when undefined; throws RangeError('max must be a non-negative integer') for non-integer or negative max; returns text unchanged if length <= max; returns tail.slice(0, max) when max <= tail length; otherwise text.slice(0, max - tail.length) + tail.
titleCase(input): words(input) with first character uppercased, joined by a single space.
Generated case converters, one per SEPARATORS entry: kebabCase(input) joins words with '-', snakeCase(input) joins words with '_'.
